what_to_detect: A creature chosen in the declaration is an attacking creature until combat ends: it is in the combat record's attackers and deals combat damage.
near_miss: A creature on the attacking player's battlefield that was not chosen and is not in the attackers.

what_to_detect: A triggered ability whose effect refers to the defending player (its Execute chain holds Defined$ TriggeredDefendingPlayer or DefendingPlayer) is evaluated and fires; its effect then falls on the attacked player or the controller of the attacked planeswalker or battle, even after the attacking creature has left combat.
near_miss: The same kind of trigger evaluated and not fired.
record_fields: the trigger line's Execute chain segments (sidecar script_text; trigger_mode reads only the root segment, and requires a mode, keyword, step or spawned_by)
the trigger's resolution record: events whose subject is the defending player
